 It’s a Frailty party and we’re all invited. Jane Remover has shared a new deluxe edition of her 2021 LP to celebrate its fifth anniversary. The new version includes the remastered original album in addition to five new tracks interspersed throughout the proceedings. While the project is now available to stream, vinyl copies of the new release will be available for pre-order beginning tomorrow.
 In other Jane news, she’s gearing up to perform at Tyler, the Creator’s Camp Flog Gnaw in LA this weekend. Jane’s set is scheduled for Saturday, November 14 at 4:05 p.m. Last we heard from Jane was in September when she dropped the hyperpop anthem “Beauty Sleep.”
